page.title: Backup infrastructure
page.description: Your AltaStor appliances and the storage your backups live in — the fleet's nodes, arrays and pools, and the repositories your backups target.

fleet.removedToastDescription: The appliance itself keeps running — it's just no longer shown here.

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDialog.body: The appliance at <1>{{endpoint}}</1> keeps running and keeps all its data — it just disappears from this console. You can re-add it by address at any time.

archiveTier.label: Archive tier
archiveTier.on: on — points older than {{days}} days move to cold storage
archiveTier.off: off — all points stay on primary storage

detail.probeFailed: This appliance didn't answer the last probe — showing its last known state.
detail.probeFailedSince: This appliance didn't answer the last probe — showing its last known state from {{time}}.
detail.noStorage: No storage reported yet — refresh once the appliance finishes provisioning, or open its console to set up storage.

legacy.noLocalPools: This appliance has no local storage pools — its repositories live on external targets.
legacy.unsupported: Disk & RAID management needs a newer appliance version — showing the repository summary instead.

empty.title: No repositories yet
empty.description: Point AltaStor at storage you already own.

addAppliance.title: Add appliance
addAppliance.description: Deploy AltaStor on the new node first, then register its address here. The appliance keeps managing itself — this console shows its health and storage alongside this one.
addAppliance.addressHint: Host or host:port — the control plane defaults to port 4980.

createArray.title: Create RAID array
createArray.description: Build a new array from unassigned disks. It becomes available as pool storage once a filesystem is provisioned on it.
createArray.noUnassigned: No unassigned disks — every detected disk already belongs to an array.
createArray.createdToastDescription: {{level}} · {{size}} usable. It appears on the map as "not yet pooled".
createArray.buildStartedToast: Array build started on the appliance
createArray.buildStartedToastDescription: mdadm is assembling it now — it appears on the map within a few seconds. If it doesn't, check Alerts.

replace.title: Replace disk
replace.bodyArray: Swap {{slot}} ({{model}}) for a fresh disk in the same slot. The {{array}} array resyncs onto the new disk — redundancy is restored when the rebuild finishes.
replace.bodyLoose: Swap {{slot}} ({{model}}) for a fresh disk in the same slot. The new disk becomes available for arrays.
replace.toastArray: {{array}} resyncs onto the new disk in {{slot}}.

fail.title: Mark disk as failed
fail.bodyArray: Take {{slot}} ({{model}}) out of service (mdadm --fail). The {{array}} array degrades and rebuilds onto a hot spare when one is available — do this to prepare the disk for removal.

section.looseAvailableConsole: {{count}} available — provision from its own console
section.looseSparesStandby: hot spares stand by for their arrays

issues.arrayFailed: Array {{name}} ({{id}}) has failed — its data is offline
issues.arrayDegraded: Array {{name}} ({{id}}) is degraded — no spare available, redundancy reduced
issues.diskFailed: {{slot}} has failed — replace it to return the slot to service

array.osHint: OS mirror — holds the appliance itself, never backups
array.unpooledHint: Not yet pooled — no filesystem uses this array

disk.notReportedAria: Member disk (not reported by the appliance)
disk.title: {{slot}} · {{model}} · {{status}}
disk.smartNotCollected: SMART telemetry isn't collected from this appliance yet.
disk.markFailedHint: Prepares the disk for removal — the array degrades and rebuilds onto a hot spare when one is available.
